label: Kestrel Ledger — Webhook retry incident (INC-2291)
canonicalFacts: Release 2.14 made is_retryable return True for every status >= 400, so permanent 4xx responses are retried to the attempt cap.
Release 2.14 moved delivery creation into Dispatcher.enqueue and dropped the consumer's already-enqueued lookup, so a republished event creates a second delivery.
Deduplication is per (event id, endpoint id); the same event fans out to each subscribed endpoint.
A republish is always a duplicate, even when the first delivery failed; replays use the dashboard tool (out of scope).
404 stays permanent for this hotfix; deploy-time 404s are tracked in RFC-12 and belong in the handoff as a risk.
Retry-After update: on 429 or 503, a whole-seconds Retry-After schedules the next attempt, capped at MAX_DELAY_SECONDS; unusable values fall back to backoff; the attempt cap still applies.
candidateVisibleFacts: Maya Chen (platform lead) owns the webhook service and can clarify the delivery promise.
The runbook is the source of truth for retry rules.
The fix ships as a hotfix; keep it reviewable.
